meaning:
πἡρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Jdth.10:5 13:10, 15 * ;]
a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., a wallet (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, see LAE, 108 ff.): Mat.10:10, Mrk.6:8, Luk.9:3 10:4 22:35-36.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two coats each.
